metric: metre-scale slope-condition coverage (share of the 3 targets' pooled valid 2 m area whose slope bin is provided by >= 1 selected site; provides = >= 5% of site valid 2 m area)
nature: current; new spatial holdout in the same region (not external validation); prototype acceptance criteria, not NASA engineering standards
step1_reason: formal ceiling: 8/8 groups have random-coverage median >= 95% (all 100%). Classification stops at Step 1; Step 2 conditions are recorded for transparency only and do not determine the branch.

verification.site_grouping: 64 windows -> 62 sites (merged: dumont+grid_r2_c3, avawatz_negctrl+grid_r4_c3); all eligible (>=95% valid at 30 m and 2 m)
verification.rejected_ring_points: ring 3 and ring 5: no/partial 3DEP 1 m coverage (2 m valid 0.0-0.21)
verification.separation: min target-candidate window edge distance 11.08 km (>= 5 km); min group-centre separation 27.5 km (>= 20 km)
verification.values: target 2 m elevations -82..1728 m; per-target median 2 m slope 0.56-27.71 deg
verification.ceiling_explanation: 33 of 62 sites provide 5 or 6 of the 6 slope bins at 2 m under the 5% rule, so random 3-site combinations reach 100% coverage
verification.pairing: COP30 (TanDEM-X DSM, 30 m) for recommendation vs USGS 3DEP 1 m lidar bare-earth DTM (CA_FEMAR9Southeast_D24 and other projects per tile list) averaged to 2 m for scoring; same 1.92 km extent and centre; vegetation/structure effects not checked per pixel (desert setting)

sample_nature: new spatial holdout (8 groups outside the Gate 2 box), same Mojave/SE California region; not external validation
consequence: INCONCLUSIVE: exploratory comparison, evidence explicitly insufficient; not a failed hypothesis. Current Moon-side method stays fingerprint A with T = 2.317, labelled exploratory.
